Global Geocoder. Returns a list of matching locations for a given search query.

Retrieves categories of establishments near a given coordinate.

Calculates the coefficient of how similar are 2 strings containing the name (and type) of the route. With a value of 0.9 and higher, it is possible to do auto-matching, at 0.2-0.9 - visual matching.
Tool schema: {"parameters": {"properties": {"str1": {"description": "The first route name to compare", "type": "string"}, "str2": {"description": "The second route name to compare", "type": "string"}}, "required": ["str1", "str2"], "type": "dict"}, "required": null}
